source_title: Bhutan lake outburst triggers flash flood alert along Sankosh river in Bengal
source_excerpt: KOLKATA: Bengal forest minister Manoj Oraon late Thursday alerted residents living along the Sankosh river in Alipurduarâs Kumargram area after reports of an outburst from Shintaphu Lake in Bhutanâs Gasa district.The lake lies in the Mo Chhu catchment, which forms part of the Sankosh river system downstream.In a message, Oraon urged residents of Kumargram tea estate, Kumargram forest village, Pakriguri and Bholka to remain alert to rising water levels in the Sankosh and warned of possible flash floods.Shintaphu Lake, located below Wakila Mountain in Lungo, Laya Gewog, Gasa, experienced an outburst on Thursday evening, according to local reports.The reports said people in the affected area had been moved to safer ground.
